steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F). Grease a 23 × 13 cm loaf pan and line the bottom with parchment.
Melt the butter in a small pot over low heat, about 2 minutes, until liquid, then let it cool a little.
In a large bowl, whisk the mashed banana, the eggs, the sugar, the melted butter and the vanilla extract until smooth.
In another bowl, whisk the wheat flour, the baking powder and the baking soda.
Fold the dry mixture into the banana mixture with a spatula, just until no dry flour shows. Lumps are fine.
Pour into the pan and smooth the top.
Bake 55 to 60 minutes, until deep golden and a toothpick in the centre comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes in the pan, then on a rack. Under 12 months, cut a slice into fingers. Keeps 3 days; freezes 2 months.
